resources.string: Settings unlocked until you leave this screen.

Volimiter helps limit media volume when audio is playing through the device speaker.
What Volimiter controls: • Media volume while the device speaker is in use • A foreground service that monitors media volume while active • Optional restart after device reboot • PIN protection before stopping Volimiter • Required Device Admin permission, explicitly granted by you, to prevent removal while active
• Optional Quiet Hours with a stricter daily volume limit
What Volimiter does not do: • It does not record audio • It does not use the microphone • It does not upload your PIN or settings • It does not limit headphone or Bluetooth volume • It does not hide itself from the launcher
Starting Volimiter requires you to explicitly grant Device Admin. This prevents normal uninstallation until Volimiter is stopped with the PIN.

Volimiter requires Device Admin permission to prevent the app from being uninstalled while it is active. This is intended for parent-managed or self-control use. To uninstall Volimiter, first open the app, enter the PIN, and stop Volimiter.
Device Admin permission is required to start Volimiter.
Volimiter stores your PIN and volume settings locally on this device. It does not record audio, use the microphone, collect personal information, or send data to a server.
You\'ll need this PIN to stop Volimiter. Don\'t forget it!
PIN must be at least 4 digits.
